scope.visibility: private to crate::model and its child source-index modules

duplicate_evidence.prior_spans: The prior Qwen30 and Qwen80 SafetensorsHeader, SafetensorsTensorInfo, and read_safetensors_header spans were identical.
duplicate_evidence.equivalence_check: The new parser body matches the prior Qwen30 parser after only the private function visibility and named MAX_HEADER_BYTES substitution.

preserved_contract.parser: The shared leaf preserves the 64 MiB header cap, Error::Model messages, __metadata__ exclusion, usize-representable shape conversion, and raw u64 data-offset extraction. It deliberately does not add file-size, byte-geometry, contiguity, duplicate-name, or offset-order validation.
preserved_contract.qwen30_index: Qwen30 keeps its existing policy: every mapped tensor must be BF16 or BFLOAT16 before its local inverted-offset check.
preserved_contract.qwen80_index: Qwen80 keeps its existing Flash-Next policy: non-BF16 control tensors are skipped before its local inverted-offset check, so its BF16 source view remains narrow.
preserved_contract.separate_owners: Gravity safetensors_inventory remains a stricter Error::Gravity byte-closure admission owner. Qwen38 remains unchanged because its structurally similar parser has different I/O and JSON error behavior.

validation.shared_parser_cases: Covers valid metadata/fields; short, zero, oversized, and truncated headers; invalid JSON and root; malformed descriptor fields; and Error::Model category/message boundaries.
validation.consumer_smoke_cases: Synthetic BF16 source/index opens and range-reads through both actual Qwen indexes. A mixed BF16/U32 source proves Qwen30 still rejects the mapped control tensor while Qwen80 still skips it and refuses a BF16-view read.
validation.fast_core_check: tools/ci/rust_test_fast.sh check core: passed; 135 direct integration sources across 10 packages

production_owner_and_consumers.interpretation: One private model-source parsing owner replaces two identical production spans, including the necessary caller imports and Qwen80 platform-specific Read import adjustment.

hermetic_regressions.interpretation: Parser and real-index regression coverage is intentionally model-free and payload-minimal.

claim_boundary: This receipt proves the one shared Qwen30/Qwen80 source-header parsing owner and the listed caller migration. It does not claim source-wide safetensors unification, Qwen38 migration, Gravity admission equivalence, full model behavior, numerical parity, Flash execution, GPU/ANE behavior, runtime throughput, daemon behavior, or deployment.
